Title: Tutorial: Craft a Snare Trap
Descriptions: Ready for your next lesson, %1? Now that you have a camp, you need food. Craft a Snare Trap using a stick and metal wire. Place the trap on the ground and apply bait to the slot. In about 30 minutes you will catch a small animal if you're lucky. For your bait: worms attract chickens, vegetables attract rabbits, and meat attracts foxes. Worms you can dig out of the ground, but you'll have to find everything else. I have an extra can of food for you when you are done. Make sure you pick up the trap after you craft it.
